short_description: The Air Science Fuming Chamber uses cyanoacrylate fuming for latent print development on various surfaces. The fuming chamber incorporates the Air Science Fume Extraction unit coupled with a self-contained filtration system to safely purge the noxious fumes when the printing cycle is complete.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including Compounding / Balance Enclosures, Microscopes and Robotic Equipment, Forensics, Histology, Educational, Microscopy, Mobile and Classroom Demonstrations, Pharmaceutical, Powder Fingerprinting, Powder Weighing, Sample Prep Work, Soldering, Solvent Cleaning and Welding, Veterinary, and Dental.
seo_content: The SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber features a self-contained filtration system that safely removes noxious fumes during the latent print development process. Its compact, space-saving design and wide range of applications make it a versatile solution for forensic labs, educational institutions, and other environments where sensitive work with powders and solvents is required.

page_content_sections.overview: The Air Science Fuming Chamber uses cyanoacrylate fuming for latent print development on various surfaces. The fuming chamber incorporates the Air Science Fume Extraction unit coupled with a self-contained filtration system to safely purge the noxious fumes when the printing cycle is complete.
page_content_sections.specifications: The SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber features an epoxy-coated steel construction and is compliant with ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 standards. It operates on 120V, 60Hz electrical power and can be equipped with a portable humidifier and hose accessory. The equipment is backed by the Air Science Legacy Limited warranty.
page_content_sections.applications: The SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber is suitable for a wide range of applications including forensics, pharmaceutical, educational, and more. It can be used for compounding, microscopy, powder fingerprinting, solvent cleaning, and other sensitive work requiring a safe, controlled environment.
page_content_sections.models: The SafeFUME Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber is available in multiple models with varying dimensions and capacities to suit different laboratory and workspace requirements.
